## 定级 `pm:queue` · `priority:p2` · `bug` · `domain:engine` —— 中、日、西三种语言的 `sys_user.role` 帮助文字仍让管理员去点一个已退役的按钮

Path: identity-auth

Triage: lands in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/{zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES}.objects.generated.ts` (`objects.sys_user.fields.role.help`) ⇒ `domain:engine`; rationale: the translated help still says to use the "Set Platform Role" action retired in #9968, while the `en` text was rewritten by PR #17102 and again by PR #19892; the leaf has no source-hash entry in any locale, so neither i18n gate can report it; a false prescription on the field an administrator reads while trying to grant platform-admin standing ⇒ p2, the same grade as its `en` sibling #19875; PR #19892 has landed, so the site is free.

分诊席(`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`),2026-09-23T16:25Z。本席读完了卡面(本卡尚无评论)。

### 本席的读数(`origin/main` `029d8a4710`)

- PR #19892(#19875)已落地(`029d8a4710`),`en` 文字已经改好。
- `zh-CN.objects.generated.ts:38`:`help: "平台级角色(admin、user 等)。通过“设置平台角色”操作设置。"`
- `es-ES.objects.generated.ts:38`:「…Se establece mediante la acción Establecer rol de plataforma.」
- `ja-JP` 同位置;本席的 grep 只命中了它的 label 行,help 行的原文取自卡面。

### 判定

- **业务后果**:用中文、日文、西班牙文的管理员,在最需要看说明的那一刻(想给某人平台管理员权限),读到的是「去点『设置平台角色』」,而这个按钮早就不存在了。中文管理员是核心用户群。
- **`p2`**,与英文那张 #19875 同级。
- **修法方向**(⛔ 不是裁定,卡面已写):
  - 把三种语言的值改成当前 `en` 文字的译文(AGENTS.md 允许直接改译文);
  - 给这个叶子补上 source-hash 记录,下次 `en` 再改时门禁能报出来。
  - ⚠️ 后一点是门禁盲区:所有语言都没有这个叶子的 hash,所以 `check:i18n` 和 `check:i18n-stale-fill` 都看不见它。同类的旧译文可能不止这一处,接手时顺手量一下,⛔ 不在本卡扩面。

## ACCEPT — round 21 · PR #19914 · `Fixes`

`domain:engine#1`, `session_01TEhopqrWQYBycZzyJHpAZr`, written 2026-09-23T18:13Z. Every reading below was taken against GitHub and `origin/main` in this act, ⛔ not from the dev's report.

### Review

| check | reading |
|:--|:--|
| head | `0807fd8143` |
| PR shape | draft → `main`; first body line `Fixes #19897`; no other closing keyword; `Clause-②: no` at column 0, agreeing with the `patch` changeset |
| scope | 4 files, +10 / −3: exactly one line (the `objects.sys_user.fields.role.help` value) in each of `{zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES}.objects.generated.ts`, one changeset. No key, structure or hash sidecar moves |
| fidelity | each value translates the current `en` text (`029d8a4710`, PR #19892) clause by clause: the verified email in `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` on every posture, and the unscoped `admin_full_access` grant on `single` only. The `single` qualifier is scoped to the second route in all three locales; code spans are verbatim |
| retired name | "Set Platform Role" and its three translations: 0 hits across every `translations/` file at head, `en` included (3 hits at the merge-base, exactly the lines replaced) |
| source-hash half | not done, and correctly so. The card offered it as "Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling)". `collectFilledFromHashes` never records a hash for a genuinely translated leaf (pinned at `source-hash.test.ts:270`). A hand entry in the generated sidecar is forbidden by AGENTS.md and the file header, and could not protect the leaf. The dev ran the tooling once; it wrote nothing |
| governed | NOT governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 19914`, 0 of 4 paths) |
| contract review | PASS on this head (5800255971) |
| CI | landing waits for every check run on this head to finish green (Lint & Repo Gates carries the live `check:i18n` / `check:i18n-stale-fill`) |

**Out-of-scope findings and open questions — dispositions:**
- The dev's open question: should genuinely translated `objects` leaves get staleness protection (the dev recommends a hand-maintained source-hash table)? **Dropped — covered by existing rulings.** #9672 ruled that a corrected source string leaving a translated locale stale is accepted-and-documented behaviour, and #10026 was closed not planned on that ruling. Its reopen condition, "a non-English user reports stale help text in production", is not met: this card came from a dev audit. #12069 then extended the source-hash sidecar to generated bundles for byte-copy fills. A translated leaf "gets no record and stays legacy-trusted" by that design (the `source-hash.ts` module note). This card is another instance of the ruled class, not a new semantic case, so the parent rulings carry with their reasons, and a new gate is default-no. The seat's reviewer recommended a `[Decision]` card instead (flag ③-1). The seat declines and names this disposition in the round report, where the maintainer can overrule it.
- 1203 / 1182 / 1173 translated `objects` leaves (zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES) carry no hash; this is the measured population triage asked for, not a stale count → **Acceptance notes**, as the evidence for the disposition above.
- The changeset says the `en` text was "renamed" (it was rewritten), and its second paragraph is more process narrative than an upgrader needs. Every sentence is true → **Acceptance notes**.

Landing: ready → queue on this head once CI is fully green.
